author: Apple
description:
A look at ROSÉ'S new music video for "new trick" shot entirely on iPhone 18 Pro. 

The new variable aperture lens on the 48MP main camera captured improved low-light footage and impressive depth of field to bring the music video to life. 

Learn more about iPhone 18 Pro: https://apple.co/46wcuqQ
Available to order starting today, 9.18

“new trick” by @roses_are_rosie: https://music.apple/newtrick
Directed by Dave Meyers.
